summary: Iteration 142 — Re-tested the 3 new Cyber Crisis Commander features after the dropped-parenthesis fix in CyberCrisisCommander.jsx L1619. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iter142_crisis_webhook_map_sse_library.py — 12/12 PASS covering webhook/test-map for all 5 vendor formats (generic/crowdstrike/splunk/sentinel/servicenow), ingest/webhook accepting native {secret,format,payload} plus 401 on bad secret, snapshot SSE stream emitting 'data:' events with correct content-type, bogus token SSE surfaces error payload, scenario/library returning 4 keys (ransomware/insider/third_party/ddos), scenario start→advance→stop, and demo cleanup. Also re-ran prior iter141 pytest → 9/9 PASS (18 total green). Frontend: logged in with admin creds (Enter on password), /app/cyber-crisis-commander renders page (data-testid=cyber-crisis-commander-page present, no white screen, no compile errors) with 12 crisis-tab-* tabs (mission, command, decisions, impact, response, warroom, recovery, regulatory, controls, timeline, briefing, defensibility) — all 12 switch cleanly. Webhook mapper preview: selecting 'crowdstrike' + sample JSON + Preview mapping populated crisis-webhook-mapped with KIND=Threat, SEVERITY=High, SOURCE=CrowdStrike. Scenario menu opens (crisis-scenario-list) and shows all 4 picks; picking ransomware shows Play/Pause/Step/Progress 'Step 1/9'/Stop controls; Step advances progress. Share Snapshot creates crisis-snapshot-bar with URL, Copy, Revoke; opening /crisis-snapshot/<token> in a no-cookie context rendered the full read-only board (LIVE indicator, KPIs, timeline, regulatory timers) via SSE. Revoke removes the bar; bogus token renders crisis-snapshot-error. Cleanup: revoked test snapshot on CRISIS-0002, called /crisis/scenario/stop, and confirmed org baseline restored (real CRISIS-0002 preserved).

ui_bugs.issue: Starting a scripted crisis scenario does NOT activate the global demo-mode-ribbon. POST /api/crisis/scenario/start succeeds and creates a demo case, but GET /api/control-intelligence/demo/state still returns {active:false}, so <DemoRibbon/> stays hidden. Request explicitly says 'Starting a scenario should activate the global DEMO ribbon.' Root cause: scenario_start in crisis_commander.py does not flip the Control-Intelligence demo flag that useDemoState polls.

action_items: In backend crisis_commander.scenario_start (and ideally webhook ingest/demo/clear), also toggle the CI demo flag consumed by GET /control-intelligence/demo/state so the global <DemoRibbon/> lights up while a scripted scenario is running, and turns off on /scenario/stop. Otherwise the on-screen ribbon requested in the spec never appears during a showcase.
critical_code_review_comments: CyberCrisisCommander.jsx is 1657 lines with WebhookFeed, scenario menu, snapshot bar, header actions and all 12 tab views inline. Extract SnapshotBar, ScenarioControls, WebhookFeed into siblings — this file already had one dropped-parenthesis regression (L1619) precisely because the JSX is that dense.

Public SSE endpoint /api/crisis/public/snapshot/{token}/stream returns 200 for bogus tokens and streams an error event instead of surfacing 404 at connect time. UI handles it (renders crisis-snapshot-error) but any generic HTTP monitor / uptime probe will treat the endpoint as healthy on garbage tokens.

useDemoState only polls /control-intelligence/demo/state and reacts to a manual 'ci-demo-changed' window event. The crisis scenario flow never fires that event nor flips that flag — the two subsystems are wired independently, which is why the ribbon bug exists.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all 3 features wired end-to-end; only gap = DEMO ribbon does not activate on scenario start)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 iter141 features (webhook mapping, snapshot SSE, sample-breach scenario library) are functional end-to-end after the L1619 parenthesis fix. The single outstanding issue is that starting a scripted scenario does not flip the Control-Intelligence demo flag, so the global <DemoRibbon/> (data-testid=demo-mode-ribbon) never appears — a small backend wiring fix in scenario_start / scenario_stop that toggles the same flag exposed by GET /api/control-intelligence/demo/state (used by useDemoState). Real cases CRISIS-0002 preserved. All test data cleaned up.
rca of the issue: DemoRibbon.jsx depends on useDemoState() which polls /api/control-intelligence/demo/state. crisis_commander.scenario_start creates crisis cases with is_demo=true and inserts into db.crisis_scenario, but never updates the Control-Intelligence-side demo flag. Reproduction: POST /api/crisis/scenario/start {key:'ransomware'} → 200 with step:1/total:9, but immediately GET /api/control-intelligence/demo/state → {active:false}. Fix: in scenario_start also mark the CI demo state active (and undo it in scenario_stop / demo/clear). Alternatively, extend useDemoState to also check /api/crisis/scenario/status.
